snippet.title: GeoStrategic Insights
snippet.description:
🌍 Welcome to [GeoStrategic Insights] 
This is shubham yadav
Your trusted source for in-depth analysis of global events, power shifts, and strategic decisions shaping the world.

We break down complex geopolitical issues—from military conflicts and diplomatic moves to economic rivalries and global alliances. Whether you're a student of international relations, a policy enthusiast, or just curious about how the world really works, this channel is your gateway to understanding the forces behind the headlines.

🔎 What We Cover:

International conflicts & crisis zones

Global power dynamics (USA, China, Russia, EU, India & more)

Trade wars & economic influence

Strategic alliances (NATO, BRICS, SCO, etc.)

Historical context behind current events

Weekly deep dives & real-time analysis

🗺️ New videos everyday

🎯 Subscribe to stay informed, think critically, and see the world from a strategic lens.
